description: This file defines a PHP class Theme within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class handles theme override logic during certain events, specifically retrieving theme information based on route and configuration, and setting a theme code if available.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling theme-related event logic, such as retrieving and setting theme codes based on the current route and configuration.
